tutorial:
I. TUTORIAL

Welcome to the Qampus tutorial! This comprehensive guide will walk you through the various features and functionalities of our platform, ensuring a seamless user experience.

I.1. Account Creation
To get started, visit our website at www.qampus.co.za and click on the 'Sign Up' button. Fill in the required information, including your name, email address, and password. Once you've completed the registration process, you will have access to all the features Qampus has to offer.

I.2. Navigation
Navigating through Qampus is easy and intuitive. Use the menu bar at the top of the page to explore different sections, such as Search, Upload, My Books, and Profile. Each section contains specific functions tailored to your needs.

I.3. Searching for Books
In the Search section, you can find the textbooks you need by typing the ISBN, title, or module code of the book. Qampus will display relevant search results, allowing you to choose from a wide range of options.

I.4. Contacting Book Owners
Once you find a book you're interested in, simply click on the cart icon to contact the owner. Qampus will automatically send an email and a message to the owner, expressing your desire to purchase the book.

I.5. Uploading Books
If you have textbooks you no longer need, the Upload section is where you can easily list them for sale. Take a picture of the book's front cover, provide the ISBN, module code, and set the asking price. After confirming the details, your book will be added to the Qampus marketplace.

I.6. Managing Your Books
In the My Books section, you can conveniently manage your uploaded books. You have the option to edit book details, mark books as sold, or remove them from your collection.

I.7. Safety Tips
Ensuring your safety is our top priority. Before meeting with buyers or sellers, we recommend following our safety tips, which can be found in the Safety section of the app. These guidelines will help you make secure transactions and protect your personal information.

I.8. Profile Customization
Your profile represents your identity on Qampus. Personalize it by adding a profile picture, updating your bio, and sharing your academic interests. To modify your profile, visit the Profile section and click on the Settings option.

I.9. Getting Directions
Qampus also provides a convenient navigation feature. In the Directions section, enter your desired destinations and click the 'Get Directions' button. Qampus will generate accurate directions that you can easily access on your phone via the Google Maps app.

We hope this tutorial has been helpful in familiarizing you with Qampus. If you have any further questions or require assistance, don't hesitate to reach out to our support team. Happy exploring and trading on Qampus!.
